title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:it-with-a-clock
canDo: I can fill the six fields of a practical Italian form inside a three-minute clock, and I know the shape of this book's twenty-minute A1 writing paper and the CILS rule that one weak part cannot be carried.

payoff.summary: Complete IT-W261-with-a-clock: six form fields against a three-minute timer, then at most one minute checking doubles and accents.
payoff.note: Timing, parts and the 30-40 word band are read out of italian/task-shapes/a1.json, which is project-defined and says so; none of it is attributed to CILS. The CILS fact the lesson ends on -- five parts, each out of 12, 7 needed in every part -- is the one italian/assessment-spec.md records from the Siena, Pavia and Buenos Aires sources it cites. CILS's own writing minutes and word counts are deliberately not restated. The lesson describes the full twenty-minute paper but clocks only its form part, so the directed time (240 s) stays inside the five-minute lesson cap.
